Reshaping to Game Level

gameLong is the workhorse: one row per participant per week per game.

Entering Weekly Winners

The matchups are read straight out of the data, so no schedule needs to be typed by hand. On the first run of a new week, a new sheet (“Week N”) is appended to Winners/winners.xlsx with blank rows for that week’s games — fill in the Winner column there (exact team name, matching Team1 or Team2) and re-render. Existing sheets and entries are never overwritten.

LLM vs. Participant Accuracy

Compares the three AI personas (run through each LLM) against real participants on three summary metrics: the percent of games picked correctly to win, the average number of tokens ended with, and the Brier score. LLM persona files are loaded automatically from LLM Personas/, named week_<N>_<Model>.csv (e.g. week_3_GPT.csv, week_3_Opus.csv) — any model name works, and new weeks are picked up automatically as files are added. Participants are compared for the same week(s) the LLM files cover, broken out by odds condition.
